messages:
nina: Customer (regulated payments) asks for a short BYO-HSM POC. Requirements: offline import ceremony, signed import receipts, 30-day key rotation, and a documented fallback policy. Can we confirm scope and quick checklist?
sam: We can do PKCS#11 or vendor import formats via Private connector. We return attestation blobs when vendor supports it.
devon: Recommend envelope encryption with short-lived DEKs to avoid per-request HSM ops. We can set DEK TTL=900s (15m) or lower as required.
sec-bot: Compliance asks: tamper-evidence photos, dual-operator approval for imports/rotations, signed import receipts, and push of all key events to their SIEM.
pricing-bot: Pricing note: onboarding + per-HSM-op. With DEK caching you'd expect far fewer lookups; estimate will depend on TTL. I'll draft a ballpark.
nina: They want a per-lookup SLA (p50 <=60ms) and credits if missed. Can Dedicated/Private commit?
devon: We can commit at the connector level with caveat: hitting the HSM per-token will likely exceed latency. Use DEK cache on inference nodes; HSM calls occur only on import/rotation/DEK refresh.
ops-bot: For geo-HA, deploy connectors in both regions and route primary->secondary. Synchronous HSM mirroring is vendor-side; we'll document choices and failover steps.
sam: Quick POC config snippet (replace <>):
```
external_kms:
  provider: customer_hsm
  connector: private-agent-v2
  pkcs11_module: /opt/hsm/lib/vendor_pkcs11.so
  key_alias: <project>/keys/llm-key
  rotation_days: "30"
  dek_ttl_seconds: "900"
  fallback_policy: "customer-opt-in"
```
nina: Perfect. Can someone attach a 1-page SOW snippet + checklist (ports, mTLS steps, import flow, acceptance tests) and a pricing ballpark? I'll share with their security lead. :thumbsup:
pricing-bot: Posted initial estimate to internal quote doc (internal link).
sec-bot: Reminder: fallback to Redwood-managed keys requires explicit written opt-in and audit trail. No silent fallback.
sam: I'll draft SOW + runbook and drop here today.
